visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Scene opens on the storefront of an Olive Young retail location. A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white ribbed polo-style crop top and a charcoal grey maxi skirt, pushes through the glass double doors. She is carrying a large white shopping bag with a prominent green circular logo. Her facial expression is cheerful and smiling as she exits the brightly lit store interior onto a tiled outdoor walkway. (2) As she steps forward, she looks directly at the camera, waving her right hand in a friendly gesture. On her left shoulder, she carries a white studded handbag. The background shows the modern glass facade of the store with visible product displays inside. The lighting is neutral and even, consistent with a clear day or bright outdoor shopping area. (3) The camera moves into an extreme close-up of the woman's left hand and forearm. Her skin is covered in over a dozen distinct swatches of makeup, including various shades of red and pink lipsticks, purple tints, and beige foundation streaks. She points at the swatches with her right hand, looking down with a playful, exaggerated expression of disbelief and shock at the amount of products she tested.
